market_candles.scope: provider-reported BINANCE futures; exchange identity UNVERIFIED

families.name: Compression-to-expansion or momentum continuation with room
Failed reversal / sweep continuation (explicitly distinct from F2)
Range rotation / auction and true-profile value interaction
Relative strength / weakness with local structural consequence
Post-shock / post-liquidation stabilization or second-leg opportunity

methods.name: Confirmed swings, HH/HL/LH/LL
methods.observable_definition: Confirmed ladder or protected high/low; structure near a consequential reference
methods.caveat: Required `known_at`, enough actual previous pivots; no retroactive ZigZag

methods.name: BOS / CHoCH / MSS
methods.observable_definition: First accepted buffered close through a pre-known comparable swing; opposing break suggests shift, displacement + prior context qualifies MSS trial
methods.caveat: Wick/noise is not BOS; multi-timeframe and ladder context required

methods.name: Horizontal S/R, supply/demand
methods.observable_definition: Separated pre-known visits, impulsive response, approach to still-valid area
methods.caveat: Zone source/age/confirmed events; do not assume hidden orders

methods.name: EQH/EQL / inferred liquidity pool
methods.observable_definition: At least two separated confirmed pivots within frozen ATR/tick tolerance; revisit/sweep proximity
methods.caveat: Inferred stop concentration, not recorded stop orders

methods.name: Liquidity sweep / reclaim
methods.observable_definition: Excursion and ordered close back through same frozen boundary
methods.caveat: F4/F5/F6 rivals; intrabar ordering not inferred from OHLC

methods.name: Order Block (OB) candidate
methods.observable_definition: Last opposite candle in a small predeclared base immediately preceding meaningful displacement + BOS; birth known **at BOS**, then unconsumed zone approach
methods.caveat: Pre-register wick/body/full-candle bounds and base length; pattern does not prove an institutional order

methods.name: Breaker / role-flip
methods.observable_definition: Existing valid OB/reference **accepted through**, followed by later opposite-side approach/retest
methods.caveat: Requires same original zone ID and failure order, not a newly invented box

methods.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
methods.observable_definition: Bullish 3-bar **non-overlap** `L_t > H_(t-2)`, bearish `H_t < L_(t-2)`; middle displacement and min width qualify meaningful subclass
methods.caveat: Zone born at close `t`, not a promise of future fill, no inference of absent trades

methods.name: Inverse FVG (iFVG)
methods.observable_definition: Previously established FVG accepted through distal edge, then later tested from other side
methods.caveat: Must reference same gap, not arbitrary inverse color

methods.name: Mitigation/zone revisits
methods.observable_definition: First/subsequent visits to a pre-known OB/FVG/S&D zone; penetration, response, accepted failure
methods.caveat: Touch ≠ unfilled institutional orders; accepted breach changes rival setup

methods.name: OTE
methods.roles: CONTEXT, targeted INITIATE only when independent structure
methods.observable_definition: Frozen confirmed impulse `[A,B]`, price retraces trial `62%–79%` band **plus** real zone/structure
methods.caveat: Fibonacci alone adds no independent proof, no self-fulfilling claim

methods.name: Candle Range Theory (CRT) variant
methods.observable_definition: **Preselected** completed 1H/4H reference candle `[L0,H0]`; later edge excursion, reclaim and structural initiative toward opposite reference
methods.caveat: Exact reference selection must precede outcome; variants differ; do not label all candle sweeps universally CRT

methods.name: PO3 / AMD prototype
methods.observable_definition: Predeclared session balance → boundary excursion → reclaim → later opposing displacement/acceptance
methods.caveat: Crypto session definition is experimental; “manipulation” is a label for measured excursion, **not intent**

methods.name: Silver Bullet
methods.observable_definition: Credible primary-source time window + independent FVG/displacement/liquidity sequence, strict timezone/DST
methods.caveat: Do not invent canonical window or assume US equities schedule predictive for 24/7 crypto; C1 trial of 10–11am NY is **not validated**; outside-window generic FVG remains eligible

methods.name: Keepssy Reversal Model
methods.observable_definition: None until primary-source exact rules supplied and reconciled
methods.caveat: Do not manufacture formula, rank, or method-specific signals

methods.name: Auction Market Theory
methods.observable_definition: Balance/imbalance, value-edge test, acceptance/rejection, failed auction, price discovery, value migration
methods.caveat: Auction language should identify actually measured price/value processes

methods.name: Volume Profile POC/VAH/VAL
methods.observable_definition: Verified price-bin executed-volume distribution and zone approach; compare fixed complete sessions
methods.caveat: Composite vs Binance-only and true vs proxy must appear in field name; complete window/binning required

methods.name: HVN/LVN / naked POC
methods.observable_definition: Documented node extremum/local minima and first visit to pre-known unfinished reference
methods.caveat: Smoothing, tie, interval, venue/time changes; a table of POC/VAH/VAL alone cannot certify nodes

methods.name: Session/anchored VWAP
methods.observable_definition: Valid anchor, later price/value extension/reclaim, value migration or rejection
methods.caveat: Exact Q/V first moment for complete bars where qualified; genuine anchor known-at and reset; proxy kept separate

methods.name: Statistical reversion
methods.roles: DISCRIMINATE, INITIATE only with conditional regime
methods.observable_definition: Past-only distribution of residuals, excursion, later failed progress, space to actual value
methods.caveat: Normalized extension alone not a standalone fade; no fake normality assumption

methods.name: Real trade-side delta/CVD
methods.roles: INITIATE on supported sources, DISCRIMINATE otherwise
methods.observable_definition: Timed, anchored price-vs-flow divergence, initiative/resistance at pre-known reference
methods.caveat: Bar-delta vs true price-bin/sequence separated; spot/perp and venue identity

methods.name: Footprint diagonal imbalance
methods.roles: TARGETED, specialist INITIATE on supported instruments
methods.observable_definition: Valid price-bin executed buy vs adjacent-bin executed sell ratio, declared min volume and ≥3 adjacent bins as **trial** stack
methods.caveat: Full coverage/bin/tick and zero denominator policy. Vendor may use different diagonal convention

methods.name: Absorption
methods.observable_definition: Repeated aggressive executed activity near a level **with limited price progress**, adequate tape, later response
methods.caveat: Cannot infer from OI or static book wall; requires real executed trade/price response and complete enough window

methods.name: Aggression exhaustion
methods.observable_definition: Declining price progress and aggressive flow across comparable repeated attempts under valid tape history
methods.caveat: Decline in volume alone not exhaustion; possible delayed breakout remains rival

methods.name: Order-book depth / walls
methods.observable_definition: Current displayed depth within stated bps, imbalance, spread/wall appearance/removal if time series complete
methods.caveat: Static snapshot does not show historical replenishment; no spoof/iceberg intent claim

methods.name: Open interest
methods.roles: CONTEXT, DISCRIMINATE, specialist INITIATE for shocks
methods.observable_definition: Native/unit-aligned ΔOI with price, funding and actual structure
methods.caveat: Does not identify newly opening longs vs shorts; coin-wide aggregates are not exact Binance perps

methods.name: Funding / basis
methods.observable_definition: Source rate/interval percentile, extreme changes, basis dislocations and timing
methods.caveat: Carry varies by venue/time, crowding can persist; no automatic reversal rule

methods.name: Reported liquidations
methods.observable_definition: Covered forced-order observations during shock, source sampling and currency units
methods.caveat: Sampled/not complete; modeled liquidation level ≠ actual execution

methods.name: Relative strength and sectors
methods.observable_definition: Persistent lag-trained residual, or broad cheap proxy followed by local structure
methods.caveat: Independent strength needs aligned data, not only top-% gain

methods.name: Volatility/market breadth
methods.observable_definition: BTC/ETH regime, cross-sectional dispersion, unusual own historic quietness and shock
methods.caveat: Macro context guides attention, never disables an altcoin method

methods.name: News/events/catalysts
methods.observable_definition: Source-verified scheduled event or asset-specific announcement with usable time
methods.caveat: External text is untrusted; no causal proof solely from temporal coincidence
